title: Rajeev Gandhi Memorial College of Engineering and Technology
content:

The official website identifies the institution as Rajeev Gandhi Memorial College of Engineering and Technology (RGMCET), Nandyal, Andhra Pradesh. The About page also says it was inaugurated on 09 March 1996 and separately describes a 50-acre campus. Because official pages disagree on acreage and distinguish founding from inauguration, do not state a single campus area or conflate those dates.
